intake.description: Capture the explicit request and effective initial scope without turning intake into a transcript.

sections.title: Request
sections.purpose: The explicit user or ticket request being handled.

sections.title: Scope
sections.purpose: Effective in-scope and explicitly out-of-scope boundaries.

sections.title: Constraints
sections.purpose: Material constraints, assumptions, and required external inputs known at intake time.

investigation.description: Evidence-backed investigation that separates verified facts from unresolved assumptions.

sections.title: Scope
sections.purpose: What is being investigated and what is explicitly out of scope.

sections.title: Evidence
sections.purpose: Verified source, test, configuration, runtime, or operational evidence.

sections.title: Findings
sections.purpose: Facts established from the evidence, with hypotheses kept separate.

sections.title: Open Questions
sections.purpose: Unresolved assumptions or external information still required.

plan.description: Implementation or delivery plan grounded in the current canonical Work Item state.

sections.title: Objective
sections.purpose: The concrete outcome this plan is intended to achieve.

sections.title: Approach
sections.purpose: Proposed technical or operational approach and important tradeoffs.

sections.title: Steps
sections.purpose: Ordered implementation or delivery steps.

sections.title: Verification
sections.purpose: How the result will be verified before completion.

sections.title: Risks
sections.purpose: Material implementation risks and mitigations.

review.description: Focused review of an implementation, change set, or proposed result against requirements and evidence.

sections.title: Review Scope
sections.purpose: What was reviewed and the requirement or standard used for comparison.

sections.title: Findings
sections.purpose: Material review findings, defects, gaps, or confirmed strengths.

sections.title: Verification
sections.purpose: Evidence used to validate review findings.

sections.title: Assessment
sections.purpose: Overall review conclusion, residual risks, and required follow-up.

report.description: Redmine-ready final report in Textile style. Follow the configured eight-section order and formatting as advisory guidance; report only verified task facts and preserve explicit user-fill placeholders when values are not known.

sections.title: h3. +1. Root-cause/requirement:+
sections.purpose: Explain the effective requirement and verified root cause. Write Redmine Textile content beginning with `p((. *Yêu cầu:* ...` when a concise requirement statement is available. Separate verified facts from assumptions; do not invent a root cause that evidence does not establish.

sections.title: h3. +2. Solution:+
sections.purpose: Describe the implemented solution or agreed handling in enough detail for Redmine review. Use normal Textile paragraphs and `* ` bullets where useful. Explain old behavior/problem, new flow, edge cases, and scope boundaries when supported by evidence; do not claim implementation that was not verified.

sections.title: h3. +3. Affected:+
sections.purpose: Summarize affected Service, Site, Device, and Chức năng using a `p((.` Textile block. Include only values established by the task/evidence; leave unknown items explicit rather than guessing.

sections.title: h3. +4. Impact Module Analysis+
sections.purpose: List directly affected modules/repositories in a `p((.` Textile block, for example `p((. sg_back`. Include only modules supported by source/change evidence.

sections.title: h3. +5. SQL_Report+
sections.purpose: State SQL report impact in a `p((.` Textile block. Use `No` only when the task evidence establishes that no SQL report is required; otherwise describe the required SQL/report work without guessing.

sections.title: h3. +6. Commits:+
sections.purpose: Write a `p((.` Textile block containing `DDL/DML: <No/Yes>` only from verified change evidence. Preserve the literal placeholder `<<branch user tự điền>>` when the user has not supplied the branch/commit text; never fabricate branch names, commit hashes, or DDL/DML status.

sections.title: h3. +7. Testcase /UT:+
sections.purpose: Write verified testcase/unit-test coverage and results in a `p((.` Textile block. Include concrete commands/results or scenario coverage when known. If verification is missing or incomplete, state that explicitly; never invent passing tests.

sections.title: h3. +8. Deploy:+
sections.purpose: Write deploy notes in a `p((.` Textile block. Preserve the literal placeholder `<<pre4 user tự điền>>` until the user supplies the deployment/pre4 value; do not fabricate deployment targets or procedures.
